verse: niḥsvabhāvamahāvasthā mantrabhūmistu sā viduḥ | sthulagā yāmadrodikkā (?) akṣarakṣaramadhyagā
kiṃ vā tubhyaṃ vahantyatāḥ (?) pṛccha tvaṃ tu paraḥ śivaḥ| kiṃ vā svabhāvabhāvena pṛcchase tu mahāmate
iti? cakrasya deveśa navamaṃ varṇanāyakam | prathamāntaṃ vijānīyād vaṣṇametat mahābalam
pūjayāmi sadā bhadre samayārthaśivapradām | kathayasya prasādena vistareṇa yathā vahiḥ
sṛṣṭicakrasya madhyasthā pūjā bhasmavilepanaiḥ | puṣpadhūpopahāraiśca vīradravyaiśca sarvataḥ
tava vaktrād viniryātaṃ vidhānaṃ tattvarūpakam | jñānaṃ sāṇavamelāpaṃ śāktaṃ śāṃbhavameva ca
yogināṃ svātma niṣṭānāṃ bodhitvā samatāṃ sakṛt | sphurate yā akrāmena sā sṛṣṭiḥ sarvatomukhī
akṣavyañjanamārūḍhā khecaratvapradāyinī | satatoditabhāvasthā antasthā citsvarūpiṇī
ṣodaśaṃtaṃ vijānīyāt sarvakālaṃ mahāmate | sṛṣṭipañcamakaṃ yad vai saṃhārāt saptame yutam
na ca bindugataṃ nātha nānodayavivarjitam | na śūnyaṃ na cā śūnyaṃ vā śūnyānāṃ bhayavarjitam
śrībhairavyuvāca purā yat kathitaṃ deva pañcadhā saṃkramakramam | teṣāṃ tu kramarājānāṃ sṛṣṭirūpāgrataḥ sadā
sarvamantrāraṇī yā vai mantrabhūmistu sā viduḥ | etāstu mantrasiddhā vai bhūmayaḥ parikīrtitāḥ
etat jñātvā prayatnena guruṃ cārādhya yatnataḥ | tena tuṣṭena vai samyag yoginyastuṣṭamānasāḥ
saṃpūrṇamuddhared rudra lakṣaṇe tu padaṃ tataḥ | bhavabandhani ca tathā rūpiṇīti padaṃ tataḥ
eṣā śatākṣarā vidyā sthiticakrasya pūraṇe | samayā sarvathā nātha samadurvāritā satī
na mantro na ca vā vidyā na madhyamakṣaraṃ na ca | na tattvaṃ na ca ekasthaṃ na ca sarvagataṃ priye
sṛṣṭisthaṃ viddhi sarvajña saptamaṃ tvadhunā śṛṇu | sthitisthaṃ tu dvitīyaṃ syāt sṛṣṭiṣaṣṭhena saṃyutam
saṃhārādaṣṭamaṃ varṇaṃ sthiternavamalāṃcchitam | prathamaṃ taṃ vijānīyād dvitīyamadhunā śṛṇu
kā devyo devadeveśi ādau pūjyāḥ kramāgatāḥ | etat kathaya māṃ devi pāramparyakramāgatam
anulome pramānākhyāṃ kālaṃsaṃkarṣayet paraṃ | (?) kālasya sarvabhakṣasya hehaṃ vai kalāsaṃbhavam
etat sarvaṃ * * * * kathayasva tu nirṇayam] | vada me parameśāni sārāt sārataraṃ param
tatrasthāstu imāḥ sarvā āgatāstu svabhāvataḥ | aṣṭāvaṣṭaguṇā divyāḥ svabhāvārādhanotsukāḥ
idaṃ praśnavaraṃ rudra akathyaṃ sarvajantuṣu ||1/ 44 ||
nistaraṅge tadoddhṛtya pareti ca padaṃ tathā | parāparepadaṃ paścāt sarvadikya padaṃ tataḥ
yena jñātena me devi nikṛttākleśasaṃtatiḥ | (?) tasya cakra parasyaiva sṛṣṭirūpasya bhairava
etat te kathitaṃ vīra mantroddharaṃ paraṃ śubham | śrībhairava uvāca śrutaṃ me tava vaktrābjād vidyā sarvārthasādhakī
ākalāvarga sahitā daśasaptākṣarā tu sā | kaṭkālakamalāntasthā khakalākalanī kulā
mahāraśmisamūhena  bhāsamānāḥ  samantataḥ ||2/20 ||
phalameva prayacchanti kālikājñānamuttamam | etat kramaṃ tu siddhānāṃ yoginīnāṃ mahātapa
catuḥṣaṣṭistu deveśyāstattvarūpāḥ  parāyaṇāḥ  ||2/6 ||
paramasiddhi ca padaṃ śuddhaśabdamataḥ param | bahuśabdaṃ tatoddhṛtya svarūpe ca padaṃ tataḥ
yoginīnāṃ tu sarveṣāṃ kā vidyā vedhakā bhuvi | kathayasva prasādena sthitibhāvapradāṃ śubhām
prāpyate paramaṃ cakraṃ khacakramakulaṃ kulam | tasmāt tvaṃ tu mahāvīra paryāye bhāvyate sadā
dvādaśa ca samāsena citsvarūpāḥ svarūpataḥ | srotrayorubhayormadhye parā yā citsvarūpiṇī
etaccaturthaṃ kathitaṃ pañcamaṃ tvadhunā śṛṇu | sthiticakrasya deveśa daśamaṃ sarvakāmadam
ye jñāsyanti mahāvīrā muktāste tava darśanāt | ataḥ paraṃ mahābhīmaṃ sarvasaṃhārakārakam
manonmani śive paścāt mahāśabdamataḥ param | balaśabdamataḥ paścāt parākramapadaṃ tataḥ
bhūyād bhāsakalāntare kakuhare koṭyakālollāsinī kālākālavaghaṭṭanodbhaṭatadiḥ koṭiprabhā ṭiṭṭi bhā varṇādhvāntanamantarāntara tayā līnā kṛṣāntekṣayā nityaṃ bhedakalātmakasya sahasācchedāyamātmākarī
guruvaktre tu sā kālī labhyate puṇyavajjanaiḥ | sṛṣṭi tu * *? kārasthā bhedinī dehamūlagā
saptādaśeti vikhyātā akṣarārthānuyāyinī | asyāḥ svarūpaṃ tu bhāvajña jñātvā vākye tu yojayet
ānandañca nirānandaṃ sānanda rakṣace * * *? | dvitīyāṃ laharīṃ viddhi śāṃbhavī kālabhakṣakī
vadasva  tat samāsena yathāvidhiranukramāt ||2/16 ||
tatra protā tu sā kalā nirācārā ninādī yā | arūpā ambarā kālī tithyante svasvabhāvataḥ
paścād bhāsākramāyātāṃ sarvaśāstreṣu gopitaṃ | akṣarā ca arūpā ca kṣarate sarvabhāvagā
viddhi bhairava jñānena sarvautkṛṣṭatayādhipa | sthitisthaṃ dvādaśamaṃ vai daśapañcamakaṃ viduḥ
sphurantī parame vyomni mantrabhūmistu sā viduḥ | adhyātmajñānarūpasya sadāntā paramāvyayā
kathitaṃ tava deveśa pāramparyakramāgatam | śrībhairava uvāca tvatprasādena vai bhadre ṣoḍaśaca yathārthataḥ
ūrdhvaṃ dvādaśage cakre parā sā bhairavīdaśā | tena mārgeṇa sā raśmiḥ śaktirūpā khamāgatā
kṛtaṃ  tu devadevyayā  yoginīnāṃ yathāvidhiḥ ||1/ 65 ||
yena vijñātamātreṇa bhavāmi kramabhājanaḥ | ke siddhāstasya tattvasya pāramparyavyavasthitāḥ
